references.text: Parallel genealogy mentioning the Pathrusites, Casluhites, Philistines, and Caphtorites – a direct parallel to Genesis 10:14.
Mentions the Caphtorites (Caphtorim) who came from Caphtor and destroyed the Avvites, which is directly linked to the Caphtorites in Genesis 10:14.
Refers to the territory of the Philistines, connected to the Philistines who, according to Genesis 10:14, descended from the Casluhites.
Prophecy against the Philistines, called 'the remnant from the island of Caphtor' – a direct link to the Caphtorites mentioned in Genesis 10:14.
The Lord says He brought the Philistines from Caphtor, clarifying the origin of the Philistines and Caphtorites mentioned in Genesis 10:14.
Prophecy concerning judgment on the Philistines, descendants of the peoples listed in Genesis 10:14.
Mentions Philistia in a psalm about God's rule over the nations, including the land of the Philistines which can be traced back to Genesis 10:14.
